tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently visited a new art gallery in your city called Art Haven. You want to share some feedback with the gallery curator, Ms. Blake.
bullets: Describe what you enjoyed about your visit to the gallery.
Explain why you think providing more information about the artists and their work is important.
Suggest ways that visitors could connect with and learn more about the gallery's artists.
tasks.subject: Art Gallery Visit Feedback
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms. Blake,

I recently visited Art Haven and wanted to thank you for a memorable afternoon. I especially enjoyed the contemporary painting rooms and the way the lighting made the textures in the ceramic pieces easy to see.

I do think visitors would benefit from more information about the artists and their work. Short labels that explain an artist's background or process would help people understand what they are looking at and remember the show after they leave.

It would also be wonderful if the gallery offered short artist talks, a printed guide, or a QR code linking to interviews. Those options would let visitors connect with the artists without crowding the rooms.

Thank you for creating such a welcoming space. I hope to visit again soon.

Best regards,
Jordan Lee
tasks.analysis: 邮件须写参观收获、为何需要更多艺术家介绍，以及观众如何与艺术家建立联系。称呼 Ms. Blake。
tasks.title: Art Gallery Visit Feedback

tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: We've been discussing the importance of customer feedback in product development. Gathering feedback can help companies understand customer needs and improve their products. However, some argue that relying too heavily on customer feedback can stifle innovation. What is your opinion on this?

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: Customer feedback is essential for product development. It helps companies understand customer needs and preferences, ensuring that products are tailored to the market. Feedback can guide improvements and enhance customer satisfaction.

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: I believe that relying too heavily on customer feedback can stifle innovation. Companies should balance feedback with creative vision to avoid producing mediocre products. Innovation often requires taking risks and pursuing new ideas that customers may not initially recognize.

tasks.sample: I agree with both Paul and Kelly, but I lean toward Kelly's warning. Customer feedback is useful for fixing problems customers already notice, such as a confusing checkout page or a battery that dies too fast. Paul is right that those signals can raise satisfaction. Innovation, though, often starts with an idea users cannot request yet. If a company only builds what surveys already rank highly, it will keep making safer, more ordinary products. A better approach is to use feedback to test and refine a bold idea, not to choose the idea itself. Feedback should guide the details; creative vision should set the direction.
tasks.analysis: 需表明立场并回应 Paul 与 Kelly。较好答法：反馈适合改进已知问题，突破性产品仍需愿景与风险。
tasks.title: Customer Feedback in Product Development
